statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during daily activities
